title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect Wisal to your ERP and communication providers
notice: Saving a connection stores its configuration and checks that the endpoint is reachable. Sending and receiving messages through these providers is not enabled in this release.

erp.label: ERP
erp.help: Sync customer and order records from your ERP system into Wisal tickets.

email.label: Email
email.help: Receive and send support tickets through a connected email inbox.

sms.label: SMS
sms.help: Send and receive customer replies over SMS.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.help: Handle customer conversations over WhatsApp Business.

api_webhook.label: Custom API / Webhook
api_webhook.help: Push and pull ticket data through a custom API endpoint.

form.savedHint: Saved key ends in {{last4}}. Leave blank to keep it.
form.testHelp: Checks that the endpoint responds. It does not verify that the provider accepts the key.

error.unreachable: Couldn't reach the endpoint. Check the URL and API key, then try again.
error.scheme: The endpoint URL must start with https://.
error.blocked_host: That address is not reachable from the server. Use a public https endpoint.
error.server_error: The endpoint responded with a server error. Try again later.
error.loadBody: Something went wrong while fetching them. Try again.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{type}}?
disconnect.body: The stored endpoint and API key for {{type}} are deleted. This cannot be undone.
